paragraphs: On Saturday, there was an open day at school. Many families came, and the school yard was full of people. May came with her brother Pat, and he wore a nurse costume. Pat had a white hat with a red cross and a long white coat. He also had a blue scarf around his neck. May looked at the games, and then Pat was not there.

"Where is Pat?" asked May. Her friends Lily and Mia came to help her, and Teacher Kim came, too. "What does he look like?" asked Teacher Kim. "He is small," said May. "He wears a white hat and a long white coat." "He has a blue scarf on his neck." "One of his shoes has a hole at the toe," said Mia. "Pat might be at the snack table," said Lily. "Let's look there first."

The girls walked through the crowd, but they did not see him. There were many people at the snack table. A man with a gray beard stood next to the table. "Excuse me," said May. "Did you see a small boy in a nurse costume?" "Yes, I did," said the man. "He has a white hat and a blue scarf." "He is at the library door." "He is looking at the books," said the man.

The girls ran to the library, and there he was. Pat sat on the floor with a big picture book about animals. "Pat!" said May. "You must stay with me." "Sorry, May," said Pat. "I like this book." May smiled and took his hand. "Thank you for helping us," she said to Lily and Mia.
text.summary: At the school open day, May cannot find her brother Pat. She and her friends describe his costume, and a man with a beard helps them find him.
